parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is one half of the scissors, consisting of a blade and a handle loop made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other blade handle set to perform the cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is the other half of the scissors, also consisting of a blade and a handle loop made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the second cutting edge and handle loop, working together with the first part to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the central joint opposite to the first blade handle set, enabling the scissor blades to open and close.
